title: Your preferences.
description: A quieter space, shaped around you.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose the light or dark theme.

language.title: Language
language.label: Application language
language.description: Choose your language. Switching keeps your current screen and entered text.
language.available: English and Spanish are bundled with the application.

privacy.title: Your journal, your choice
privacy.description: Your journal is saved on this device. Optional private cloud sync, account settings, and backups will follow in later stages.

profile.title: A little about you
profile.description: Make this space feel like yours. These details stay on your device.
profile.name: What should we call you?
profile.nameHint: A first name or nickname—whatever feels right to you.
profile.cityHint: Your city or town is enough.

reminders.title: A gentle reminder, twice a day
reminders.privacy: Discreet reminders are on by default. Scripture previews are optional. Your journal is never shown in notifications.
reminders.confirmed: Reminders are on. We’ll meet you tomorrow at {{time}}.

install.title: Get reminders on your iPhone
steps: Open Ebenezer from your Home Screen and turn reminders on.

blocked.title: Notifications are blocked for Ebenezer
steps: Open your browser’s settings for this site (the icon beside the address).
Come back and turn reminders on in Settings.

reminders.unsupported: This browser can’t show reminders. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or Safari on an iPhone with Ebenezer added to the Home Screen.

errors.blocked: Notifications were blocked. You can allow them in your browser’s site settings.
errors.dismissed: No problem. You can turn reminders on anytime.
errors.not_ready: Notifications aren’t ready. Reload Ebenezer, then turn reminders on again.
errors.failed: Reminders couldn’t be updated just now. Please try again.

settings.title: Reminders
settings.description: Morning and evening reminders in {{timeZone}}. Change the times or turn them off anytime.
settings.discreetNote: On: only “A moment for you”. Off: public English Scripture may appear on your lock screen after you consent.
settings.sent: Sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
settings.previewTitle: Show Scripture on your lock screen?
settings.previewDescription: Morning notifications will include an English Bible verse, reference and publisher credit. Evening notifications mention Jesus. Anyone who can see your lock screen may see them. Your journal and personal thoughts are never included. You can return to discreet wording anytime.

encounter.description: Your Word from {{date}}. Take a quiet moment when you’re ready.
encounter.invitation: Pause with this passage. What does it help you notice about Jesus’ love? Questions are welcome.
encounter.reflect: Pray, reflect, and build a stone
encounter.missing: The original notification passage is no longer available on this device. You can open Today to choose a new reading.
